searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: One or more keyword queries to look up. Each term is searched independently against eBay's completed/sold listings.

ebayDomain.title: eBay domain
ebayDomain.description: Which regional eBay site to search.

itemsPerPage.title: Items per page
itemsPerPage.description: Number of results requested per page (eBay's _ipg parameter). 240 minimizes the number of requests.

maxPagesPerSearch.title: Max pages per search term
maxPagesPerSearch.description: How many result pages to fetch for each search term before stopping. Pagination stops early if a page returns no items.

maxItems.title: Max total items
maxItems.description: Global cap on the number of items pushed to the dataset across all search terms. Set to 0 for no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: eBay blocks datacenter and unproxied traffic quickly. RESIDENTIAL proxies are strongly recommended.
